location_lifecycle.label: Delivery Center Lifecycle
location_lifecycle.help: Operational lifecycle of a delivery center or operating site. Occupancy, booking availability, and record activation are separate.

planned.help: The delivery center or operating site is being prepared and has not started operating.

operational.help: The delivery center or operating site is operating. This does not indicate vacant space or booking availability.

under_maintenance.help: The delivery center or operating site is undergoing maintenance; operating restrictions are managed separately.

temporarily_closed.help: Operations at the delivery center or operating site are paused with an intention to reopen.

closed.help: Operations have ended at the delivery center or operating site.
